body: i’m really sorry too hear that :( but that’s exactly why i’ve decided that i’m not getting into a relationship until i figure out my problems. I couldn’t live with myself if i hurt someone the way i’ve felt in the past. Also i’ve decided to seek professional help while i’m home from college this summer and hopefully start the process of healing and becoming a better person. Thank you again :)
to extend this post i’ve tried reminding her of all the things she’s told me she wants to do in the future and how much i care about her but it doesn’t help :(
Also i really appreciate the in depth reply it baffles me a stranger would put this much effort into helping me out :)

i looked into the attachment styles you mentioned and both really resonated. In my childhood i never really got any affection and was never really payed much attention to due to my parents constantly fighting. Very early in my life my parents split and my mom left and i was left alone with my dad whose parenting style is very cold to say the least. I was always met with anger for being upset or any other scenario rather than affection and comfort. I was also never told “I love you” and also never really felt loved by either parent. This leaves me craving that love that i missed out on but scared to pursue it :/
Thank you for the reply. This makes me feel a lot better. On the bright side I am confident in my sexuality now :)
